title: VSift handoff.skeleton data v1
description: The data member of a complete handoff.skeleton result (0.3.0, ADR 0038 section 1): a handoff that is valid but states nothing yet, written by VSift from one open session's records so that an agent never builds the handoff JSON from a text template. handoff is a complete handoff v1 that validates against the skill-owned skills/vsift/handoff.schema.json and passes handoff check, also with --session naming the same session: status insufficient_evidence, the question as given, capabilities.image_access unavailable and transcript_basis from the session's newest transcript revision, the one a plain transcript get reads (the open revision while a background transcription runs; none without one), session with session_id, source_id and, when the session has a transcript, revision_id, empty claims, citations, gaps and untrusted_instructions, and lifecycle.action left_open. fill lists, as RFC 6901 pointers into handoff, the members only the agent can supply, in the order it fills them. The command reads the session read-only and never renews it.

handoff.description: A complete handoff v1 (skills/vsift/handoff.schema.json) that states nothing yet.
